caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven textile featuring alternating horizontal bands of intricate floral and geometric patterns. The textile uses three main colors: red, blue, and off-white (the off-white functioning as the background). The top band consists of stylized red and pink flowers with geometric leaf motifs. Below this, a blue floral and geometric band follows a similar structure. Alternating color bands continue, each with various symmetrical motifs—some bands dominated by floral medallions and others by a repeating, more linear design. In the lower left corner, there is a rectangular section with text woven into the fabric in red, reading: "MADE BY J.W. LIRICK IN ST. PARIS CHAMPAIGN CO. OHIO 1850 FOR CATHERINE KINDLE." The border of the textile includes a repeating diamond pattern along the vertical edge on the left, and a scalloped design in brown at the bottom. The textile is displayed flat on an off-white background, with a slight shadow indicating its thickness.
title: Hand Woven Coverlet
